profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at AppFolio, Inc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
•	Develop new features for a large and complex Ruby on Rails App
•	Maintain and update current features
•	Work in conjunction with Product, UX, and QA to break down a given feature into manageable parts
•	Maintain open channels with stakeholders as the project continues to develop
•	Maintain a flexible mindset, to allow for quick changes in design and execution and conditions warrant it

positions.title: Supervising Sales Associate
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
•	Advise customers on computer choices.
•	Provide a friendly relaxed atmosphere for customers
•	Train new staff on store procedures.
•	Maintain and update store documents and price lists.
•	Make sure that store shelves are stocked and that the organization of store displays are optimized for ease of perusal.

positions.title: Network Performance Assistant
positions.locationName: Oberlin College Center for Information Technology
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
•	Assist with network performance and troubleshooting.
•	Install and set up Windows and Linux servers.
•	Install, set up, and maintain Apache web servers.
•	Write Perl, Bash and Expect scripts for data organization and analysis.
•	Update scripts written by previous students to meet new requirements.
•	Set up and troubleshoot various aspects of the print server including, but not limited to, Web Print and Print Release Stations

positions.title: Network Technician
positions.locationName: Oberlin College Center for Information Technology

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: Santa Barbara County, California, United States
positions.description:
Developed full stack iOS apps in Swift and Python-based backend technologies that allowed users to interact seamlessly with their 3D printers.

Worked in a cross-functional team, designing, planning and executing projects for the company's flagship app. 

Set weekly goals and met with stakeholders on a regular basis to ensure that the app was up to spec.

Participated in carrying out user-testing, including observation and analysis afterwards.

Participated in weekly journal clubs with the software team to discuss best coding practices, user experience, and user-centered design

positions.title: IT System Administrator
positions.description: Hardware and software support including acquisition of new computers and long term planning.

positions.title: Summer Camp Counselor - Technology Instructor
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
•	Build a temporary computer lab for the purpose of computer instruction.
•	Design and implement a curriculum aimed at teaching kids between 1st and 5th grades about how computers work, the basics of programming, and the creative possibilities available when using computers.
•	Foster a positive and fun environment for the kids to learn computer skills in.
